Title: Antimalarial activity (MMV Data)
Description: Predicts in vitro antimalarial activity against the Plasmodium falciparum NF54 strain with four classifiers Ersilia trained with its LazyQSAR package on 72-hour screening data contributed by Medicines for Malaria Venture, one per cut-off and readout, an IC50 below 1 uM and a single-point inhibition of at least 50%, each measured by lactate dehydrogenase and by luminescence. Five-fold cross-validation gave AUROC above 0.70 for all four. Agreement between the two detection methods is more convincing than either alone.
Interpretation: Four Plasmodium falciparum NF54 inhibition probabilities, IC50 below 1 uM and 50% single-point, by lactate dehydrogenase and luminescence.
